name: Tiktaalik
introduce:
LTX-22 Tiktaalik
A Medium ST developed by Laniakea and extensively deployed by the NDF during the Milkhama War.
This ST utilizes advanced armor processing technology and is equipped with basic optical observation systems on the head and chest sides, providing specific frontal combat capabilities.
Due to its simple and reliable characteristics it is still active in various areas of the UNCS.
